concerns.text: Step 4 describes LLM inference but never explicitly ties the generated files to the `GeneratedOutput` schema defined in `contracts/generatedoutput.schema.yaml`. Adding a statement such as “each generated file is validated against the `GeneratedOutput` schema” would close the plan↔data‑model link.

Step 5 extracts surface and intent entities but does not reference the `EntitySet` definition from `data-model.md`/`contracts/entityset.schema.yaml`. Explicitly stating that the JSON outputs conform to the `EntitySet` schema would ensure plan↔data‑model consistency.

Step 6 computes precision/recall/hallucination metrics yet fails to mention that the per‑sample rows are written to `data/processed/fidelity_metrics.csv` and validated against the `FidelityMetric` schema. Adding this reference aligns the plan with the data model.

Constitution IV (Single Source of Truth) requires every statistic to trace back to a unique data row. The plan does not state that the statistical results (e.g., p‑values, effect sizes) are linked to the corresponding rows in `fidelity_metrics.csv`. Including a note that the analysis reads directly from that CSV and records the source row IDs would satisfy the SSoT requirement.
